summary: Admitted F106, F107, F108 and F109 from Jujutsu continuation 3 as four accepted corrections ready for compile. F110 is an unapproved optional capability and is excluded. Canonical edits and independent review remained pending at this point.

Compiled the four corrections into JJI-002, JJI-003, JJI-008, SCS-003 and SCS-017 and their existing schemas and fixtures. Every cited passage was re-read against current main first; all six cited canon files were byte-identical to the frozen 2026-09-13 review snapshot, so no correction was dropped as already covered.

Recorded passing contract, configured shard and plan index checks, and the ledger validator result. Two F107 relational rules, the count arithmetic and in-page node_ref uniqueness, land as owner obligations only because JSON Schema cannot express them and the contract semantic gate lives in scripts/, outside this thread's edit scope. Canonical compilation is complete; landing on main remains pending reviewer approval.

Applied the independent review of commit b83abd9396 as a second commit on the same branch. B1: the 600-reference parent bound is kept mechanically but restated in SCS-017, the bundle README and this ledger as a provisional owner bound rather than a derivation from the edge budget, and recorded as open question q-001. B2: the F108 evidence attribution to premium-J0021.json and premium-J0019.json was withdrawn because neither contains F108 content, replaced by independent-review.json candidate 2 and the out-of-repository J0026-compare captures it records by path and hash, with the out-of-repository note extended to name F108. S1: a 600-reference positive and a 601-reference negative fixture now cover the parent bound. S2: cor-002 and dec-002 carry the partial-enforcement clause. S3: q-002 records the semantic-gate question with Jared's authorizing answer. N1: placeholder timestamps were replaced with the real work-window instants.

Both questions raised by this ledger are closed. q-001 is answered by the owner: 32 parent references per node in a page, with the rest fetched by a bounded follow-up under the page-continuation fences; the provisional 600 is retired. q-002 is implemented: the authorized source_control_contracts branch of contract_semantic_failures now enforces the two relational rules and the SCS-017 unenforced statement is removed. Both land on branch plans/jj-f110-20260916, with the owner answer recorded as DL-052 in Plans/Decision_Log.md. This ledger stays compiled; the follow-up work belongs to pldg-20260916-002-jujutsu-object-format-picker and to that branch.
